input.quote: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
input.rationale: The only cap in the Agreement (p0077) is one-way: it limits TrueLink's liability to 12 months' hosting and support compensation, while Client's liability — including under the very broad Section 12a indemnity — is entirely uncapped. A cap protecting only the Vendor with the Customer uncapped is walk-away territory under LOL-CAP, so the clause fails even the fallback (mutual 12-month cap with carve-outs). There is also no mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages anywhere in the document. The redline makes the cap mutual at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, keeps indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap, and confirms Client's payment obligations are not capped liability.

proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual, apply it to the Agreement as a whole, and place indemnity/confidentiality/misconduct claims outside the cap.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made the cap mutual and set it at the greater of 12 months' fees and USD 1,000,000, since as drafted only TrueLink's liability is limited while Client's exposure (including under the Section 12 indemnity) is unlimited. Indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and Client's payment obligations are not capped liability.

ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID OR PAYABLE FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE 12 MONTH PERIOD IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) USD 1,000,000. "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY COMPENSATION DUE UNDER SECTION 5 IS NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION.
